description: Canonical policy master for the target platform. Fully documented; every attribute has a stable business name, type, and description.

attributes.name: policy_reference
attributes.description: Unique policy identifier / reference number.

attributes.name: tax_file_number
attributes.description: National taxpayer identification number for the policyholder.

attributes.name: investor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the investor / contract holder.

attributes.name: life_assured_full_name
attributes.description: Full name of the life assured (the insured individual).

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: Policy inception date — when cover incepted.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: The type of pension or insurance product the policy represents.

attributes.name: commencement_date
attributes.description: Date the policy started — entry into force, or cover start.

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the policy.

attributes.name: exit_date
attributes.description: Date the policy terminated or exited; null while the policy is active.

attributes.name: exit_reason
attributes.description: Reason the policy exited; null while the policy is active.

attributes.name: premium_unpaid_since
attributes.description: Date premiums first fell unpaid, for lapsed policies; otherwise null.

attributes.name: scheme_reference
attributes.description: Group scheme identifier; null for individual policies.

attributes.name: scheme_name
attributes.description: Name of the group scheme; null for individual policies.

attributes.name: employer_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the sponsoring employer for a group scheme.

attributes.name: annual_premium
attributes.description: Premium annualised to a single yearly amount.

attributes.name: sum_assured
attributes.description: Sum assured or benefit amount for the policy.

attributes.name: is_group_policy
attributes.description: True when the policy belongs to a group scheme, false otherwise.

attributes.name: gone_away
attributes.description: Policyholder gone-away: correspondence returned, no current contact, latest trace failed.

attributes.name: vulnerable_customer_flag
attributes.description: True when the policyholder is recorded as a vulnerable customer requiring additional care.

attributes.name: loyalty_bonus_amount
attributes.description: Accrued loyalty bonus payable to long-standing policyholders, derived in the source system from policy tenure, product type, sum assured and status.

attributes.name: early_exit_penalty_percent
attributes.description: Percentage penalty applied on voluntary early exit (surrender or transfer) before the penalty-free point, including any market value adjustment.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Code identifying the originating source system.

attributes.name: migrated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp at which the record was migrated into the target platform.
